name: Consecutive Parents for Cumulative Path Fibers
statement: Let a maximum-generated class project onto the path $00,10,11$ and have nonempty private fibers $C_0,C_1,C_2$. On one extension of the private coordinates there are nested maximum classes of three consecutive ranks with one common marked section equal respectively to $C_0$, $C_0\cup C_1$, and $C_0\cup C_1\cup C_2$. The cumulative chain starting from $C_2$ has another such certificate, which need not be compatible with the first.
proof: Attach two controls encoding the implications $p=1\Rightarrow a=0$ and $q=1\Rightarrow b=0$; one-coordinate product closure supplies a maximum parent after projecting away the original path controls. Adjoin a constant marked coordinate and take a maximum parent. Its projection, one-coordinate reduction followed by projection, and two-coordinate full reduction are nested maximum classes. Properness and a full control square force their ranks to be three consecutive values, while commuting the operations with the common mark yields the three cumulative unions.
